notes.title: Design-a-Mission Update #1 - Finalizing the Cast
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246535/6c41d0748094c7a1f46bf054bf7cc35da308ccda.png"]

Hey Guardians!


Missed the first update? Click here! Now, onto our new news!  


We’ve crunched the numbers, ran many playtests, and crunched some more numbers, but the community mission is just about ready to reach your main screens in our next update. 


We recently unveiled at PAX West our latest gameplay mode—One Shot Mode—and our community mission will be part of that update later this year! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246535/0b8d9744b6c220a58387aae4113ee74bf1e00b3f.png"]We’re in our new game mode era


Now, onto the nitty gritty details… 

Revenants? Added

Teleporters? Added

Mimics? Double added!

Length? So long you guys

Difficulty? Ehehehehe… 

There were a lot of elements you all voted for, so once you put them all together, you get this! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246535/41c30545f244a3fe8d609c53d178c1614db4fce8.png"]Just kidding! Can you imagine?
  

While this won’t be the FINAL look of the mission, rest assured, this has everything that our community voted for, and possibly even more! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246535/68d4e332821f65f306737f58fe9dd22950746091.png"]This will all make sense once you play.  


Ok THIS is what you’ll be greeted with once you download the new update later this fall:  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246535/fe67e2b5ce64adb92d20d27fab4f6d07d3f2062d.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246535/458d705b64ac7bbccda70aa3c2a94fe4e4203fcf.png"]It’s so CLEAN


Thank you to Discord user CaramelKhorne (amazing username btw) for the name suggestion! We simply couldn’t pick any other name than this one. 


Our next update will be… gameplay! Stay tuned for more info in the following weeks, including more looks into our upcoming Patch 1.5!


Stay connected with us through our socials and through our official Discord server for more announcements on upcoming events and updates. 


Have a great day!

The Sunderfolk Team

notes.title: Design-a-Mission Update #1 - Setting The Stage
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246535/1917942b9a02517e5b7beb40b2fdb2508845f534.png"]

Hey Guardians!



You voted and our design team heard! The community collab mission has been underway for a few weeks now, and we’re pretty pleased with the progress. We’ll be updating everyone on the process for creating this event, starting… NOW! 



As a refresher, here’s the criteria that our amazing community voted for:  



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246535/f275720442b3d2931a138f73ba104c17a0a70e56.png"]
[p align="center"]THIS IS WHAT YOU ASKED FOR


Once we had the final votes for everything, we shipped them off to our design team, who immediately got to work! 



[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcdKcuZ0PATRGJIL50QW46TszecHMvy7LLC6iknbV_wF8-VkcnH2R5w5TK4u0jg-goeM18XkL3SQOJ_Uyo9RRjJa8-B-F9bCpd-bpXOz657w_PQrxfne6wCunAVrdTvSWOTNqT3dA?key=CCCWi4Xpikrpv-d0J5beXA"]

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeVCsb2xqdrrhDnU7YQS7j0nzqfY2HeDHG8At56ypJenWzU7TVc7E7tcwtds4sbgW8aPqrnJtxX4zLmJcmgHCP1S2u5VCiPK50xyLl8Qjwpz00EGxlGClzACT9o2HljmlIX4Du8qA?key=CCCWi4Xpikrpv-d0J5beXA"]
[p align="center"]Game design


Then after that is picking the best map that matches the gameplay, and of course, what our community voted for!



[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfFz36XwAl7HBvuEmL9j-jVgSvovB8MaAt2z5FkJcrzso2qBBVeZQjoYWuFN10ipgPfFrzmxHzb4VAn4WlC8C__XPHgUA9S8zarGHavzUnGtdi19r0XCdr5sQi6Ygs_2BvNmrMqfQ?key=CCCWi4Xpikrpv-d0J5beXA"]
[p align="center"]One of theeeeese is the final winner! Can you guess which one it is? 



After some thinking, light touches of creativity, and design madness, the concept begins to form: 



[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdAx3VaIYQDT17F0gz0MorXUD2myUPJNP6UDmyFzmV78wXAOwD2Ff--c35vqMFkUysyGEYIBFk7uNG1lj_kg8K4bf-QG-lpuWQnqXD8rXeW0hOg4IabASXXGE8l7nGXHu51cIibGA?key=CCCWi4Xpikrpv-d0J5beXA"]
[p align="center"]Memes are vital to the design process. 


After some more brainstorming and iteration, a gameplay loop forms, and with that, a mission begins its first steps into the world. 


[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXd9LW5LnllaW60NNOT0GABU2zchSUEo1GSLYW78HMPIbUENqLOq0umhDY4-0lELIEfq-xc0mj54oZwPfDozFp8rQwvb5kkLQdSsnF7dyu6QjS2xy4Cgy911MQunu2SdZIBfe5XouQ?key=CCCWi4Xpikrpv-d0J5beXA"]
[p align="center"]Button Mushroom decided to block the level reveal. The little rascal! 


Stay tuned for our next update where we’ll reveal the map and the mission name! That’s right, the community voted for the name too! You can see the results of that on our Discord! 


If you simply can’t wait for the community mission reveal and you happen to be attending PAX West this year, we HIGHLY recommend stopping by! You might just be able to have your wish fulfilled. <3



We’ll see you soon, Guardians! 

The Sunderfolk Team

notes.title: Sunderfolk Update #4 - 1.4.1 Hotfix Notes
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246535/59c9beaf8903e53da323830dee189bb0686fe703.png"]

Hello Guardians! 



We’ve been hard at work on fixing disconnection issues that have been affecting some Sunderfolk players, and we’re excited to have a fix for our Guardians. 


Hotfix 1.4.1
Fixed an issue where some players would experience frequent disconnections between the Sunderfolk main screen and phone controller app. 

This particular issue was caused by some firewalls dropping a required server connection due to limited network activity over the connection. This disconnect would most likely have been experienced while playing remotely over the Internet. The game now handles this situation better.

Please note, this hotfix may not prevent every possible network disconnection issue, and we always appreciate your feedback and reports for finding and squashing bugs.



Thank you!

The Sunderfolk Team

notes.title: Sunderfolk Update #3 - 1.4 Patch Notes & Summary
notes.notes:
[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXewDjKumDYkqNBSSfuC1uI75GPls-KFOc9A_UESdJ4XawtYkMPqRUReoq9oCZVMxx-Kd69Y3ss9fuH6C0MVuNTc8URepaCybOlUGKpGposXPhiozDbMsuhj5078KQOVcc9HDiYtSg?key=dXOucwgLmqQ9mGthZxm1kLxP"]

We discovered that you can, in fact, make a salad too powerful. Image credit to Discord user SilentBob4207. 



Hey Guardians!

You’ve spoken, and we’ve heard! We’ve been collecting your feedback and seeing where Sunderfolk shines and where it needs polish.


This latest patch focuses on some popular community requests, as well as an expressive new feature.😁 


What’s New / Priority Fixes in Sunderfolk 
Now introducing: Emotes

Players can now use Sunderfolk emotes with customizable text during combat and in-town. 

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeazcNiQ6OhmRBs7WFEmycE-Ud4Yeu99CGI-YgVNpgwAQR-Eh2rNnnkrISZ6D9HzdgdzPAP76nGdmNOY4QtBkTVDZ_H2L_hrwLfTqILBkFVmtbv6h-W0qSjM3wcApzrrERn_MvYbQ?key=dXOucwgLmqQ9mGthZxm1kLxP"] Just click the Smile icon and go nuts! This will appear in town and during missions! 

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf5GPiX2JiHenkpt6U3IyK0UkWriAPWcF37zRZUBds1OkoTuwR_rtLyJ0iDoGTqh7B4zEBNgaPbDY1bY_Rz_PukHxWWDZ0OPW2PRWIpyhN32R8C0NAzKm-O11AB-phW5uEzQm1s?key=dXOucwgLmqQ9mGthZxm1kLxP"]

Renameable Player Prompts

Were you too much of a loremaster and now you have to show your campaign to your family? We’ve got your back! Players can now rename the in-game prompts through the Shared Settings menu. 

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfvWy99FMDWhDXyxv61AUBHvdY0IArUgEhKDDO50qDovWchj98BWGW3SBj9wOPn5nxCFdDdUTM3NyuGH7fCW-jh4lYE_WAtg2qVvgMxQtvjL_462N-wuzkX4k3qLMRWZHqlxKA3eQ?key=dXOucwgLmqQ9mGthZxm1kLxP"]

Name/Rename Your Campaign

Players will now be able to name their campaign party as part of the Hero Select process, which will be used as the Save File name. 

Players may change their party name later via the Shared Settings menu. 

For players already in existing campaigns, you can create a new name for your party through Settings -> Shared Settings -> Campaign Rename. 

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfAphr_7ylUNILu1MljdBu0m52RLmmk26Te_iRiPMc1uysEDrysUBpgf9qWjD-9wSFz3y0HwQbgntZ6O5FEBg4gRbnEuGpyWFxNhgvtqe1bad-OhcWRziyNiIfH3jbjKt9O0b17DA?key=dXOucwgLmqQ9mGthZxm1kLxP"]

Adjusted Boss Difficulty for Challenging/Shadowstone

Boss monsters now receive a +1 damage buff like other monsters, instead of the unique +2 damage buff previously used. 

Nerfed the Salad

The Tangleroot Salad has been adjusted to prevent excessive creation of Vines. 

The flavor text description for Tangleroot Salad has been updated. 
General Bugs & Issues FixesEncounters
Fixed an issue where the Ogre Queen would not take damage at the start of her turn if on a lava hex while Stunned. 
Characters
Fixed an issue where Heroes will no longer gain an extra level when re-adding Heroes that had been previously dropped. 

Adjusted the tooltip information for Berserker’s Rage ability to show the correct information. 
Equipment
Fixed an issue where players that joined mid-campaign did not gain the appropriate Fate Cards from the hero level-up rewards. 

Fate Card Adjustment: Executes with enemies under 5 HP now work with area-of-effect and Ranged attacks. 

Donated Trinkets will now prioritize being pulled from the player’s inventory before their equipment slots when donating at the Bug Pens.

Fixed an issue where if multiple players attempted to donate Trinkets at the Bug Pens at the same time, only one user would be able to donate Trinkets. 
NPC Conversations
Adjusted several incorrect NPC conversations in town. 

New players who join an ongoing campaign will no longer be able to speak with Evelyn indefinitely. 

Town upgrades are now accurately displayed in the Bug Pens menu when multiple upgrades are made in a row. 

Fixed an issue where a conversation with Tuya would not disappear from the Tavern location and can be seen multiple times, locking out further conversations with other NPCs. 

(This section contains story spoilers! Read at your own risk) Fixed an issue where conversations with the Rabbits after the Sundership Down quest failed to appear after completing it.

Don’t worry, if you don’t see something you’d like, continue leaving feedback! The best places are on our socials and on our Discord server. 



Thanks for playing, and we’ll see you in Arden. 

—The Sunderfolk Team

notes.title: Sunderfolk Update #2 - 1.3 Patch Notes & Summary
notes.notes:
Hey Guardians!



We’re cooking up lots of stuff behind the scenes for Sunderfolk, and we’re so excited for this latest patch! We’re focusing on bug fixes, bringing some quality of life additions, and little doses of love!



Please note: The update will be released across all platforms simultaneously, but due to platform differences, you may see the update available for download at different times. Until both your Sunderfolk main game and Controller mobile app are updated, you will not be able to connect and play Sunderfolk. We expect the update to be available to all players (across all platforms) within 30 minutes of patch release time. All platforms will receive the update by 10AM PDT / 1PM EDT / 17:00 UTC.


What’s New / Priority Fixes in Sunderfolk 
Timestamps on Last Saved Campaign 

The Campaign screen will now display the time when it was last auto-saved for the active campaign. 

Main Screen Player Prompt

The main screen now shows whose personal screen needs to respond before it can proceed. 

Auto-Save Notice

An Auto save notice will now appear on Game Start

New VFX

New visual effects have been added for the following:

Spider Webs

Redcap Spawners

Rubble

The Mimic Shrine

Minecart

The “Charge” ability

Mission Balance Change

(This is a story-spoiler: Read at your own risk) Adjusted the enemy spawns for 2-3 player games in the mission \[spoiler]Caravan Protectors, Dead of Night Pt. 1.\[/spoiler]

Smithy Tier 4 Upgrade Fix

Fixed an issue where upgrading the Smithy to Tier 4 was not rewarding players with the additional Skill Card slot. 

Device Disconnections

Reduced the frequency of disconnections under certain remote play situations.

Please note: While most players who experienced these problems should see less disconnections, we are still actively investigating further improvements related to connection reliability and for players unable to reconnect via QR code after being disconnected in a future patch. 
Upcoming June 17th
The Sunderfolk Free Trial

Play the first 3 tutorial missions and one Act 1 mission during the trial. 

Your trial save will continue if Sunderfolk is purchased. 
General Bugs & Issues Fixes
Encounters

During the “War Council” encounter, Chirp will now successfully escape once they complete their mission objective. 

The encounter "Shadow and Flame" now appears at the gates at the appropriate time during progression.

The Sentinel now correctly performs "Defy Defeat" when adjacent to a hero or allied actor, instead of repeatedly casting "Preserve" in the encounter "Sentinel's Pledge".

Revenants will now correctly drop "Revenant Shard" upon being defeated. 

Characters

Inspired Heroes will no longer follow leaping spiders into pits. 

A missing Zihao conversation is now available upon unlocking the Smithy for the first time. 

Fixed an issue where the Arcanist was unable to use certain Skill Cards during the first round of an encounter after cancelling their choice. 

Allies can now take damage from the Sentinel's "Sundering Blade" attack.

Ally Ooozlings may now swap with Heroes and Allies during their moves.


Equipment

The “Lit Oil Lamp” Trinket can now create fire on hexes occupied by gold coins. 

Descriptions for trinket rewards are now accessible while on the victory screen.

Fixed an issue where the “Lucky Coin” Trinket incorrectly dealt damage twice to enemies surrounding the exploded gold pile. 

Fixed an issue where the “Thread Dissolvent” Trinket could sometimes prevent mission objectives from progressing after using it to clear webs in the encounter “Smuggler’s Run”. 

An issue preventing tooltips from appearing on certain weapons has been fixed.

General Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue preventing saves during the victory screen when an encounter was completed. 

Mimic Shrines can now heal the Sentinel.

An issue relating to selecting donated items for building upgrades has been fixed.

Mid-encounter vignettes are now able to play when a personal device is still on a tutorial.

Player numbers on personal screens now match the main screen when reconnecting.

Custom weapon names now appear as intended during combat.

The Frenzy status icon now appears correctly in combat.


Stay tuned for June 17th when the Sunderfolk Free Trial arrives! 



We’ll have more updates to share in the coming weeks, so please keep sharing your feedback in the Sunderfolk Discord. Thanks for playing, and we’ll see you in Arden!


The Sunderfolk Team

notes.title: Sunderfolk Update #2 - 1.2.1 Hotfix Notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246535/abc90087609613dc0007976cbab12995af3ef3fb.png
Hey Guardians!
Our developers have cast their own special kind of Pyromancy spell, the Hotfix! This update fixes issues across multiple platforms, including a particularly pesky bug that caused QR codes not to load properly for some players.

As always, thank you for all your help in finding and squashing these bugs!

Hotfix Notes‍
 All Platforms  

 Fixed an issue where some players would not have a QR code displayed on the main menu.
 The 'Increase Hand Size' and 'Passive upgrade' level up rewards are now awarded as expected when an unclaimed Hero performs multiple level ups.

 Xbox | Steam  

 Fixed an issue that prevented authentication with “Dreamhaven Online Services” for some players.

 Steam Deck  

 Sunderfolk no longer freezes for some players when launching the starting sequence.
 Resolution settings now display as expected.

The folks behind the Secret Door are continuing to look into some other issues that have been reported, so don’t go too far! We’ll be sharing more updates with you Soon™️. Please keep letting us know your feedback in the Sunderfolk Discord, or sharing your bug reports with our Player Support team. 

‍See you soon around the Sunderlands!

- The Sunderfolk Team

notes.title: Sunderfolk Update #1 - 1.2 Patch Notes & Summary
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246535/93473c61ffdca1aaaba388ab7731eafd3ced9990.png
Hey Guardians!

Our first post-launch patch for Sunderfolk focuses on fixes for a few bugs and generally improves your Sunderfolk Controller experience! Thank you for your help in finding and squashing these bugs! (Don’t tell Esi)

Priority Fixes
Stuck on “Press Any Key” Splash Screen

 Made improvements to handling certain networking situations where some players may have been unable to continue past the "Press Any Button" startup splash screen.

While we've made improvements in our networking, there are more improvements / fixes coming in future patches we are actively working on. Specifically:

 In some situations, players may see a blank QR code on the main menu screen for a period of time before it properly updates with a valid QR code.
 Some Steam Deck players have also reported being unable to bypass the startup screens (logos / splash screen).  We are actively investigating those reports and working on a fix.

Arcanist “Stargate” Softlock

 Fixed an issue where players may have experienced a softlock after an Arcanist uses their “Stargate” ability on Wurmsbait [to teleport to the second island] during the mission “Wurmsbait’s Mischief”. 

Updated Incorrect/Mismatched Fate Card Text

 Adjusted text on one of the Bard’s Negative Fate Cards to correctly indicate its intended effect. 
 The original text “A random Hero or Ally in Range 3 of you Heals 3” has now been changed to “Choose a Target in Range 3 to Heal 3” 
 The Negative Fate Card “-2 Damage, Blind Each Monster in Range 2” now correctly inflicts Blind instead of Provoked.
 
Berserker “Grisly Force” Skill Card Adjustment

 The Berserker’s “Grisly Force” ability now ignores any active Shield buff on the Berserker to deal the intended damage when the “Deal” action occurs. 

Rogue “Penny Pinch” Skill Card Adjustment

 Fixed an issue where gold and loot did not always spawn on the map when a Rogue used their “Penny Pinch” Skill Card.

Rogue Chroma Fix

 Fixed an issue where the Rogue’s applied Chroma color reverted to default when gaining Evasion. 

General Bugs & Issues Fixes
Missions

 The Ogre Queen no longer uses “Retaliation” when under the “Confused” debuff. 
 Enemies will now automatically lose the “Provoked” status at the end of their turn. 
 Fixed an issue where Bosses no longer clear the “Root” debuff automatically at the end of their turn. 
 Fixed an issue where enemies with Teleport and Leap abilities were gaining Haste buffs with the “Frenzy” passive. 
 Fixed an issue where Guard Bug Allies summoned from Trinkets no longer skip their remaining actions when swapping with a Hero. 
 Ally attacks will no longer trigger enemies’ Frenzy passive in Challenging or Shadowstone difficulty. 
 Chirp is now able to use their Move action after activating her “Bulldoze” ability and dealing damage to enemies. 
 [This is a story-spoiler: Read at your own risk] [spoiler]Fixed an issue where a Round Timer is missing in (“All That Glitters”), causing the missions to be blocked from progressing. [/spoiler]

Character

 [This is a story-spoiler: Read at your own risk] [spoiler]Fixed an issue where Heroes would lose more than the intended one Skill Card when deselecting a Skill Card while under the effects of “Fear”.[/spoiler]

General Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where players may experience a main screen freeze after changing settings during missions. 
 Fixed an issue where spamming the “+” add button on Character Select causes a softlock for players. 
 Fixed an issue that was causing looping conversations.
 Fixed missing and broken audio events in-game. 
 Adjusted the description for the “Black Inkwell” trinket to match its functionality. 
 [This is a story-spoiler: Read at your own risk] [spoiler]The mission (“Sundered Shadows”) will be reset to start from the beginning if it was saved and players quit in-progress.* [/spoiler]

*Developer Note: Some patches for Sunderfolk may reset the specific mission you are on at the time of the update, if we’ve made changes to how that specific mission works. This will send you back to town, but it will improve your overall experience with the mission. We’ll aim to give more advanced notice if these resets are coming in future patches. Thanks for rolling with it! 🎲

Don’t see an issue you reported? Don’t worry, this is just the beginning of our upcoming patches, so stay tuned!

Thanks for playing Sunderfolk! 

The Sunderfolk Team

notes.title: Inspired by classic DnD, turn-based RPG Sunderfolk just got a release date
notes.notes:
I am very much in my Dungeons and Dragons era (insert sparkle emojis on either side). I'm still on my first real playthrough of Baldur's Gate 3, I've got an IRL campaign running, and I lull myself to sleep to the absolute chaos of Brian Murphy's Not Another DnD Podcast. When I first caught wind of Sunderfolk, a new turn-based fantasy RPG from ex-Blizzard CEO Mike Morhaime's Dreamhaven, I knew for a fact that it was an absolute must-play. I've been keeping track of it ever since, and during this evening's Dreamhaven showcase, it's finally got a release date - and we won't be waiting long.
